supporting.name: NavierStokes.Comparator.ForceConditionDecay
supporting.text:
/-- Force conditions for the Navier-Stokes problem on all of $\mathbb{R}^n$. The force must be smooth and decay faster than any polynomial in both space and time (condition 5 in Fefferman's paper). -/
structure ForceConditionDecay {n : ℕ} (f : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) extends ForceCondition : Prop where
  toForceCondition : ForceCondition f
  /-- All derivatives of f decay faster than any polynomial in space and time (condition 5). For any derivative order $m$ and any decay rate $K$, there exists $C$ such that $\lVert \partial^m_{x,t} f(x,t) \rVert \le C/(1+\lVert x \rVert+t)^K$ for $t \ge 0$. -/
  decay : ∀ (m : ℕ) (K : ℝ),
      ∃ C,
        ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)),
          ∀ t ≥ 0,
            ‖iteratedFDerivWithin ℝ m (↿f) (Set.univ ×ˢ Set.Ici 0) (x, t)‖ ≤ C / (1 + ‖x‖ + t) ^ K
supporting.label: Force conditions for the Navier-Stokes problem on all of $\mathbb{R}^n$.

supporting.name: NavierStokes.Comparator.InitialVelocityConditionDecay
supporting.text:
/-- Initial velocity conditions for the Navier-Stokes problem on all of $\mathbb{R}^n$. In addition to being smooth and divergence-free, the velocity must decay faster than any polynomial at spatial infinity (condition 4 in Fefferman's paper). This condition ensures the velocity field has finite energy and reasonable behavior as $\lVert x \rVert \to \infty$. -/
structure InitialVelocityConditionDecay {n : ℕ}
    (u₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) extends InitialVelocityCondition : Prop where
  toInitialVelocityCondition : InitialVelocityCondition u₀
  /-- All derivatives of u₀ decay faster than any polynomial (condition 4). For any derivative order $m$ and any decay rate $K$, there exists a constant $C$ such that $\lVert \partial^m u_0(x) \rVert \le C/(1+\lVert x \rVert)^K$. -/
  decay : ∀ (m : ℕ) (K : ℝ),
      ∃ C, ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m u₀ x‖ ≤ C / (1 + ‖x‖) ^ K
supporting.label: Initial velocity conditions for the Navier-Stokes problem on all of $\mathbb{R}^n$.

supporting.name: NavierStokes.Comparator.NavierStokesExistenceAndSmoothnessRn
supporting.text:
/-- A solution to the Navier-Stokes equations on all of $\mathbb{R}^n$ with appropriate decay and energy bounds. In addition to the basic solution properties, we require: - The velocity is in $L^2$ at each time $t \ge 0$ (finite kinetic energy) - The total energy remains bounded for all time (condition 7) -/
structure NavierStokesExistenceAndSmoothnessRn {n : ℕ} (nu : ℝ)
    (u₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (f v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
    (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ → ℝ) extends NavierStokesExistenceAndSmoothness : Prop where
  toNavierStokesExistenceAndSmoothness : NavierStokesExistenceAndSmoothness nu u₀ f v p
  /-- The velocity is square-integrable at each time $t \ge 0$ (condition 7). -/
  integrable : ∀ t ≥ 0, MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun x => ‖v x t‖) 2 MeasureTheory.volume
  /-- The kinetic energy $\int \lVert v(x,t) \rVert^2\,dx$ remains uniformly bounded for all time (condition 7), where the integral is the Lebesgue integral. -/
  globally_bounded_energy : ∃ E, ∀ t ≥ 0, ∫ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)), ‖v x t‖ ^ 2 < E
supporting.label: A solution to the Navier-Stokes equations on all of $\mathbb{R}^n$ with appropriate decay and energy bounds.

supporting.name: NavierStokes.UniformAngularReset.ResetWitness
supporting.text:
/-- A reset for the actual scheduled debt, including the uniform first angular jet estimate needed for later profile estimates. -/
structure UniformAngularReset.ResetWitness (d : TailData) (K : ℝ) : Type where
  coefficients : ℝ → AngularMomentReset.Coeff
  smooth : ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) coefficients
  angular : ∀ (eta : ℝ),
      ∫ (u : ℝ),
          Real.exp (AngularMomentReset.angularSlope d.core.lam * u) *
            AngularMomentReset.relative (coefficients eta) u =
        UniformAngularReset.normalizedDebt d eta
  pressure : ∀ (eta : ℝ),
      ∫ (u : ℝ),
          Real.exp (AngularMomentReset.pressureSlope d.core.lam * u) *
            ((1 + AngularMomentReset.relative (coefficients eta) u) ^ 2 - 1) =
        0
  coefficient_bound : ∀ (eta : ℝ), ‖coefficients eta‖ ≤ K * d.core.lam ^ 28
  eta_derivative_bound : ∀ (eta : ℝ), ‖deriv coefficients eta‖ ≤ K * d.core.lam ^ 28
  small_jets : ∀ (eta u : ℝ),
      |AngularMomentReset.relative (coefficients eta) u| ≤ 1 / 2 ∧
        |deriv (AngularMomentReset.relative (coefficients eta)) u| ≤ d.core.lam / 4
supporting.label: A reset for the actual scheduled debt, including the uniform first angular jet estimate needed for later profile estimates.

supporting.name: NavierStokes.HeatedOutgoing.CompensationWitness
supporting.text:
/-- The coefficients are obtained below from the actual physical heat debts. The base profile, hence its original reset and amplitude, is retained. -/
structure HeatedOutgoing.CompensationWitness (F : OutgoingProfile.Profile) (XR C : ℝ) : Type where
  radius_pos : 0 < XR
  switch_large : 1 ≤ OutgoingDilation.switchRadius F XR
  coefficients : ℝ → HeatedOutgoing.Coeff
  smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) coefficients HeatedOutgoing.parameterDomain
  moments : ∀ eta ∈ HeatedOutgoing.parameterDomain,
      TerminalCompensation.physicalMoments OutgoingDilation.compensationPatch F.data.core.lam
            (OutgoingDilation.patchRadius F XR) (OutgoingDilation.shapedPatchAmplitude F eta)
            (coefficients eta) +
          ParametricTerminalCompensation.physicalDebt F … [+54 characters]
  coefficient_bound : ∀ eta ∈ HeatedOutgoing.parameterDomain, ‖coefficients eta‖ ≤ C / OutgoingDilation.switchRadius F XR
  derivative_bound : ∀ eta ∈ HeatedOutgoing.parameterDomain,
      ‖derivWithin coefficients HeatedOutgoing.parameterDomain eta‖ ≤
        C / OutgoingDilation.switchRadius F XR
  first_jet : ∀ eta ∈ HeatedOutgoing.parameterDomain,
      ParametricTerminalCompensation.FirstJetWithinBound OutgoingDilation.compensationPatch
        (OutgoingDilation.shapedPatchAmplitude F) coefficients HeatedOutgoing.parameterDomain eta
        (C / OutgoingDilation.switchRadius F XR)
  patch_positive : ∀ eta ∈ HeatedOutgoing.parameterDomain,
      ∀ (X : ℝ),
        0 < X →
          0 <
            TerminalCompensation.physicalProfile OutgoingDilation.compensationPatch F.data.core.lam
              (OutgoingDilation.patchRadius F XR) (OutgoingDilation.shapedPatchAmplitude F eta)
              (coefficients eta) X
supporting.label: The coefficients are obtained below from the actual physical heat debts.

supporting.name: NavierStokes.NominalConeAssembly.Certificate
supporting.text:
/-- Every assertion concerns the same physical fields and absolute histories. The extra lower speed condition is asserted only on the two regions where the pre-modulation construction proves it. -/
structure NominalConeAssembly.Certificate {F : OutgoingProfile.Profile}
    (W : NominalProfile.Witness F) : Prop where
  relaxed : ∀ (p : ProfileHistories.Point),
      NominalConeAssembly.activeLeft W < p.1 →
        p.1 < NominalConeAssembly.activeRight W →
          p.2 ∈ HeatedOutgoing.parameterDomain → ActivationContinuation.IsRelaxed W.profiles F.data.h p
  initial : ∃ t,
      0 < t ∧
        t ≤ W.controls.activationTime ∧
          ∀ (y eta : ℝ),
            0 < y →
              y ≤ t →
                eta ∈ HeatedOutgoing.parameterDomain →
                  NominalConeAssembly.IsTrue W.profiles F.data.h
                    (NominalConeAssembly.chart (NominalConeAssembly.activeLeft W) (y, … [+5 characters]
  outgoing : ∀ (y eta : ℝ),
      F.data.core.holdStart ≤ y →
        y < OutgoingTail.tailEnd F.data →
          eta ∈ HeatedOutgoing.parameterDomain →
            NominalConeAssembly.IsTrue W.profiles F.data.h
              (NominalConeAssembly.chart W.controls.radius (y, eta))
supporting.label: Every assertion concerns the same physical fields and absolute histories.

supporting.name: NavierStokes.OutgoingProfile.Specification
supporting.text:
/-- All fields in this specification refer to one `Profile`, hence one reset and its associated corrected energy root. -/
structure OutgoingProfile.Specification (F : OutgoingProfile.Profile) (C : ℝ) : Prop where
  amplitude_smooth : ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) F.amp
  angular_smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) F.E OutgoingProfile.domain
  axial_smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) F.U OutgoingProfile.domain
  momentum_smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) F.H OutgoingProfile.domain
  pressure_smooth : ContDiffOn ℝ (↑⊤) F.Pi OutgoingProfile.domain
  angular_positive : ∀ p ∈ OutgoingProfile.domain, 0 < F.E p
  amplitude_bounds : ∀ (eta : ℝ),
      eta ^ 2 ≤ 1 →
        9 / 10 < F.amp eta ∧
          F.amp eta < 6 / 5 ∧
            |deriv F.amp eta| ≤ C * F.data.core.lam * (1 + Real.log (1 / F.data.core.lam))
  mass_integrable : ∀ (eta : ℝ), MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun X => F.U (X, eta)) (Set.Ioi 0) MeasureTheory.volume
  angular_integrable : ∀ (eta : ℝ),
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun X => F.H (X, eta) * F.U (X, eta)) (Set.Ioi 0) MeasureTheory.volume
  mass_total_zero : ∀ (eta : ℝ), ∫ (X : ℝ) in Set.Ioi 0, F.U (X, eta) = 0
  angular_total_zero : ∀ (eta : ℝ), ∫ (X : ℝ) in Set.Ioi 0, F.H (X, eta) * F.U (X, eta) = 0
  after_pulse : ∀ (eta X : ℝ),
      0 < X → F.data.core.endpoint ≤ Real.log X → F.U (X, eta) = 0 ∧ F.M eta X = 0 ∧ F.J eta X = 0
  energy_integrable : ∀ (eta : ℝ), MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (F.energyDensity eta) (Set.Ioi 0) MeasureTheory.volume
  energy_zero : ∀ (eta : ℝ), eta ^ 2 ≤ 1 → F.totalS eta = 0
  renormalized_integrable : ∀ (eta : ℝ),
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun X => F.H (X, eta) - F.powerH X) (Set.Ioi 0) MeasureTheory.volume
  renormalized_zero : ∀ (eta : ℝ), ∫ (X : ℝ) in Set.Ioi 0, F.H (X, eta) - F.powerH X = 0
  eventual_power : ∀ (eta X : ℝ),
      0 < X →
        OutgoingTail.tailEnd F.data ≤ Real.log X →
          F.U (X, eta) = 0 ∧
            F.E (X, eta) = F.powerE X ∧
              ∫ (u : ℝ) in Set.Ioc 0 X, F.H (u, eta) = X * F.H (X, eta) / (1 - F.data.h)
  ideal_prefix : ∀ (eta X : ℝ),
      0 < X →
        X ≤ 1 →
          F.E (X, eta) = F.data.core.P * OutgoingSchedule.shape eta * X ^ (1 / 10) ∧
            F.U (X, eta) = 4 * eta ∧
              F.Pi (X, eta) =
                F.axisDatum eta +
                  5 / 2 * F.data.core.P ^ 2 * OutgoingSchedule.shape eta ^ 2 * X ^ (1 / 5)
  pressure_integrable : ∀ (eta : ℝ), MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (F.canonicalKernel eta) (Set.Ioi 0) MeasureTheory.volume
  pressure_canonical : ∀ (eta X : ℝ), 0 < X → F.Pi (X, eta) = -(1 / 2) * ∫ (u : ℝ) in Set.Ioi X, F.E (u, eta) ^ 2 / u
  same_axis_datum : F.axisDatum = SchedulePressure.axisPressure F.data
  axis_limit : ∀ (eta : ℝ),
      Filter.Tendsto (fun X => F.Pi (X, eta)) (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds (F.axisDatum eta))
  analytic_axis_datum : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (SchedulePressure.complexAxisPressure F.data) PressureDatum.strip ∧
      ∀ (eta : ℝ), SchedulePressure.complexAxisPressure F.data ↑eta = ↑(F.axisDatum eta)
supporting.label: All fields in this specification refer to one `Profile`, hence one reset and its associated corrected energy root.

/-- The full assertion of Theorem 1.1: at every positive viscosity there is a candidate whose same prescribed force and zero datum have no global smooth solution with uniformly bounded kinetic energy. This is a target proposition, not an asserted theorem. -/
def NavierStokesR3.ProblemStatement.breakdownStatement : Prop :=
  ∀ (ν : ℝ),
    0 < ν →
      ∃ u p f K,
        NavierStokesR3.ProblemStatement.CandidateProperties ν u p f K ∧
          ¬Nonempty (NavierStokesR3.ProblemStatement.GlobalFiniteEnergySolution ν f)
supporting.label: The full assertion of Theorem 1.1: at every positive viscosity there is a candidate whose same prescribed force and zero datum have no global smooth solution with uniformly bounded kinetic energy.

chapters.shared: variable (ν : ℝ)

-- with P b hb
theorem exists_normalized_repair :
    ∃ g ε C,

                normalizedMap P b (g d) = d ∧
                  ‖g d‖ ≤ C * ‖d‖ ∧ ‖fderiv ℝ g d‖ ≤ C ∧ ∀ (x : ℝ), 0 < x → 0 < x ^ b + e P (g d) x

supporting.text:
/-- The whole-space solution class, retaining the source's finite, uniformly bounded energy. -/
structure EulerExistenceAndSmoothnessR3 (u₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))
    (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℝ → ℝ) extends EulerExistenceAndSmoothness : Prop where
  toEulerExistenceAndSmoothness : EulerExistenceAndSmoothness u₀ v p
  integrable : ∀ t ≥ 0, MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun x => ‖v x t‖) 2 MeasureTheory.volume
  globally_bounded_energy : ∃ E, ∀ t ≥ 0, ∫ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), ‖v x t‖ ^ 2 < E
supporting.label: The whole-space solution class, retaining the source's finite, uniformly bounded energy.

supporting.name: Euler.EulerSobolevExistenceAndSmoothnessR3On
supporting.text:
/-- Scalar-pressure Euler on a time set `I` in the original theorem's smooth Sobolev class. The velocity and its strong time derivative have continuous L² spatial jets of every order. The Euler equation uses this derivative witness. As in `IsSmoothScalarEuler`, the time law and scalar-pressure equation are required at interior times. There is no endpoint derivative condition. We use `Ico 0 T` for a maximal lifespan and `Icc 0 T` for a closed interval. -/
structure EulerSobolevExistenceAndSmoothnessR3On (I : Set ℝ)
    (u₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))
    (v : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3))
    (p : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → ℝ → ℝ) : Prop where
  div_free : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), ∀ t ∈ I, divergence (fun x => v x t) x = 0
  initial_condition : ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), v x 0 = u₀ x
  velocity_smooth : SobolevSmoothOn I v
  pressure_differentiable : ∀ t ∈ interior I, Differentiable ℝ fun x => p x t
  euler : ∃ w,
      SobolevSmoothOn I w ∧
        (∀ t ∈ interior I, HasDerivAt (fun s => toL2 fun x => v x s) (toL2 fun x => w x t) t) ∧
          ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)),
            ∀ t ∈ interior I,
              w x t + (fderiv ℝ (fun x => v x t) x) (v x t) = -gradient (fun x => p x t) x
supporting.label: Scalar-pressure Euler on a time set `I` in the original theorem's smooth Sobolev class.

supporting.name: Euler.InitialVelocityConditionDecay
supporting.text:
/-- Every spatial derivative of the initial velocity decays faster than any polynomial. -/
structure InitialVelocityConditionDecay (u₀ : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)) extends InitialVelocityCondition : Prop where
  toInitialVelocityCondition : InitialVelocityCondition u₀
  decay : ∀ (m : ℕ) (K : ℝ),
      ∃ C, ∀ (x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 3)), ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m u₀ x‖ ≤ C / (1 + ‖x‖) ^ K
supporting.label: Every spatial derivative of the initial velocity decays faster than any polynomial.

structure PhysicalGeometryData (α : Type u_1) : Type u_1 where
  center : α
  B : ℝ → EulerSmoothLimit.Space →L[ℝ] EulerSmoothLimit.Space

  M : α → ℝ → EulerSmoothLimit.Space →L[ℝ] EulerSmoothLimit.Space

  hchild : ℝ
  S : Set ℝ
  sigma_pos : 0 < σ
  sigma_small : σ ≤ 1 / 4
  y_pos : 0 < y
  y_small : y ≤ 1 / 2
  target_le_horizon : y⁻¹ / σ ≤ H
  horizon_le_Theta : H ≤ Θ
  short_extension : H - y⁻¹ / σ ≤ 1
  a_lower : 1 / 2 ≤ a
  epsilon_pos : 0 < ε
  Theta_lower : 1 ≤ Θ
  G_lower : 1 ≤ G
  d_nonneg : 0 ≤ d
  ray_scale_pos : 0 < s₀
  slope_nonneg : 0 ≤ lam
  delta_nonneg : 0 ≤ δ
  child_nonneg : 0 ≤ hchild
  small : 1000000 * neighborStabilityConstant * (16 * (ε * Θ * (4 * G) ^ 2 + d)) * Θ ^ 40 ≤ 1
  compression_guard : 60 * (G + d) * (y⁻¹ / σ) * ε < a
  time_maps : Set.MapsTo (physicalTime t₀ a ε) (Set.Icc 0 Θ) S
  M_continuous : ∀ (ξ : α), ContinuousOn (M ξ) S
  B_derivative : ∀ t ∈ S, HasDerivWithinAt B (B₁ t) S t
  old_ray_equation : ∀ t ∈ S, HasDerivWithinAt m (-(ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (B t)) (m t)) S t
  old_velocity_equation : ∀ t ∈ S, HasDerivWithinAt v (-(B t) (v t) + (2 * inner ℝ (m t) ((B t) (v t)) / ‖m t‖ ^ 2) • m t) S t
  ray_equation : ∀ (ξ : α), ∀ t ∈ S, HasDerivWithinAt (r ξ) (-(ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (M ξ t)) (r ξ t)) S t
  velocity_equation : ∀ (ξ : α),
      ∀ t ∈ S,
        HasDerivWithinAt (w ξ)
          (-(M ξ t) (w ξ t) + (2 * inner ℝ (r ξ t) ((M ξ t) (w ξ t)) / ‖r ξ t‖ ^ 2) • r ξ t) S t
  old_ray_nonzero : ∀ t ∈ S, m t ≠ 0
  old_velocity_nonzero : ∀ t ∈ S, v t ≠ 0
  old_tangent : ∀ t ∈ S, inner ℝ (m t) (v t) = 0
  initial_tangent : ∀ (ξ : α), inner ℝ (r ξ t₀) (w ξ t₀) = 0
  B_bound : ∀ t ∈ S, ‖B t‖ ≤ G
  B_derivative_bound : ∀ t ∈ S, ‖B₁ t‖ ≤ G ^ 2
  E_bound : ∀ (ξ : α), ∀ t ∈ S, ‖E ξ t‖ ≤ d
  parent_decomposition : ∀ (ξ : α),
      ∀ t ∈ S,
        M ξ t =
          B t +
              primaryShear c m v t •
                ((InnerProductSpace.rankOne ℝ) (EulerPacketNormalizedPrimary.unit (v t)))
                  (EulerPacketNormalizedPrimary.unit (m t)) +

  initial_tilt : rescaledFrame B m v t₀ a ε 0 2 1 = a * σ ^ 2
  initial_shear : rescaledShear c m v t₀ a ε 0 = a / ε ^ 2
  initial_ray_error : ∀ (ξ : α),
      EulerPacketRay.norm3 (scaledRay m v (r ξ) s₀ t₀ a ε 0 0) (scaledRay m v (r ξ) s₀ t₀ a ε 0 1)
          (scaledRay m v (r ξ) s₀ t₀ a ε 0 2 - 1) ≤
        16 * (ε * Θ * (4 * G) ^ 2 + d)

        16 * (ε * Θ * (4 * G) ^ 2 + d)

      (EulerMeanFixedSobolevGevrey.operatorBlockAmplitude ι q T Rc CF CF₁ CH CM

chapters.label: Genuine coherent input budgets for the drift-aware all-order correction theorem.
chapters.conceptText:
/-- Genuine coherent input budgets for the drift-aware all-order correction theorem. Full background norms enter the proved polynomial constants; only the actual transport drift enters the shrinking-radius slope. -/
structure Budget (period : ℝ) [Fact (0 < period)] {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 < T)
    (A : EulerAllOrderCorrectionData.Data period T) : Type where
  /-- The actual common inverse metric and its genuine time derivative. -/
  metric : EulerCorrectionEnergyData.MetricBudget period T ⋯
      (EulerAllOrderCorrectionData.Data.atOrder period A 1)
  /-- The common positive shrinking radius. -/
  radius : C(↑(Set.Icc 0 T), ℝ)
  /-- The common scalar dominating the proved nonlinear growth constants. -/
  growthCoefficient : ℝ
  /-- The desired common correction bound. -/
  delta : ℝ
  /-- The common initial radius. -/
  initialRadius : ℝ
  /-- Actual coefficient, full-velocity, drift and residual bounds at every construction order. -/
  spatial : (q : ℕ) →
      (hq : 6 ≤ q) →
        EulerDriftCorrectionBudget.Budget period ⋯
          (EulerAllOrderCorrectionData.Data.atOrder period A (q + 1 + 1)) (q - 4) radius
  /-- The common scalar bounds each actual proved energy constant. -/
  growth_bound : ∀ (q : ℕ) (hq : 6 ≤ q),
      EulerCorrectionEnergyMajorants.combinedConstant period (spatial q hq).full
          (EulerAllOrderCorrectionData.Data.metricBudget period A ⋯ metric (q + 1)) ≤
        growthCoefficient
  /-- The target error is strictly positive. -/
  delta_pos : 0 < delta
  /-- The target error is at most one. -/
  delta_le_one : delta ≤ 1
  /-- The initial radius is strictly positive. -/
  radius_pos : 0 < initialRadius
  /-- The actual drift permits retention of half of the initial radius. -/
  decay : ∀ (q : ℕ) (hq : 6 ≤ q),
      2 * growthCoefficient * ((spatial q hq).drift + delta) * T ≤ initialRadius / 2
  /-- The coefficient scale fits the initial radius. -/
  scale : ∀ (q : ℕ) (hq : 6 ≤ q), initialRadius * (spatial q hq).full.Rc ≤ 1
  /-- The actual residual bound beats the genuine Gronwall factor. -/
  small : ∀ (q : ℕ) (hq : 6 ≤ q),
      2 * (spatial q hq).full.residual * Real.exp (3 * growthCoefficient * T) ≤ delta / 2
  /-- The same actual radius is used at every order, with slope determined by the drift envelope. -/
  radius_eq : ∀ (q : ℕ) (hq : 6 ≤ q) (t : ↑(Set.Icc 0 T)),
      radius t = initialRadius - 2 * growthCoefficient * ((spatial q hq).drift + delta) * ↑t
  /-- The prescribed approximation satisfies the actual lifted divergence constraint. -/
  divergence : ∀ (t : ↑(Set.Icc 0 T)),
      A.approximation.field t ∈ EulerLiftedGradientSpace.divergenceFreeSpace period A.κ A.direction
